impact_reason.description: Brief reason for the impact rating (max 120 characters), explaining which organizational level was impacted and why
impact_reason.title: Impact Reason

impact_score.description: Impact rating from 1 to 10, where 1-3 is individual level, 4-6 is section level, 7-8 is wing level, 9-10 is HQ strategic level
impact_score.title: Impact Score

related_achievements.description: List of specific achievements within this theme, including both activities performed and their outcomes. Each achievement should capture what was done and its measurable impact (e.g., 'Developed cross-reference methodology reducing discrepancies by 35%').
related_achievements.title: Related Achievements

theme.description: Name of the achievement theme grouping related accomplishments
theme.title: Theme

vision_verification.description: If vision data confirms this achievement theme, set to 'supported'. If vision data contradicts it, set to 'contradicted'. If NO vision data appears in your prompt or it does not exist for the specific achievement, set the key to 'none'
vision_verification.title: Vision Verification
